title: 天净沙·春
author: 白朴
intro: A spring scene painted almost entirely with nouns: warm sun, soft breeze, willows, a swing, singing orioles, dancing swallows, a little bridge over flowing water. Simple words, a bright picture.
analysis: 白朴写过春、夏、秋、冬四首《天净沙》，这是第一首。全曲只有二十八个字，几乎全是名词，一个接一个排开，就像一幅画：春天的山、温暖的太阳、柔和的风；栏杆、楼阁、窗帘；院子里有杨柳和秋千；黄莺在叫，燕子在飞；小桥下流水潺潺，水面飘着落花（“飞红”）。不用动词连接，只把景物摆在一起，让读者自己去看、去感受，这种写法叫“列锦”，马致远的《天净沙·秋思》“枯藤老树昏鸦”也是这样。不同的是，《秋思》冷清悲凉，这首却明亮温暖，充满生机。最后的“飞红”是落花，暗示春天正在过去，热闹里带着一点淡淡的惜春之情。
analysisEn: Bai Pu wrote four songs to the tune “Sky-Clear Sand”, one for each season; this is spring. It has just 28 characters, and almost all of them are nouns, laid out one after another like a painting: spring hills, warm sun, gentle breeze; railings, pavilions, window curtains; willows and a swing in the courtyard; orioles singing, swallows darting; a small bridge over flowing water, with fallen petals (“flying red”) drifting on it. There are hardly any verbs linking these images — the poet just sets them side by side and lets you look for yourself. This technique, a string of noun images, is the same one Ma Zhiyuan used in his famous “Autumn Thoughts” (“withered vines, old trees, crows at dusk”). The difference is the mood: Ma’s autumn is bleak and lonely, while this spring is bright, warm and full of life. Only the last image, “flying red” — falling petals — hints that spring is already passing, adding a light touch of regret to all the colour.
background: Bai Pu (1226–after 1306) was one of the great Yuan playwrights, author of Rain on the Parasol Trees. As a boy he lost his family in the fall of the Jin capital and was raised for a time by the poet Yuan Haowen; he never took office under the Yuan.

imagery.name: 柳
imagery.zh: 院中杨柳青青，是春天最典型的颜色。
imagery.en: Green willows in the courtyard — the signature colour of spring.

imagery.name: 燕
imagery.zh: 飞舞的燕子和啼叫的黄莺，让画面有声有动，充满生机。
imagery.en: Dancing swallows and singing orioles add sound and movement to the picture.

imagery.name: 桥
imagery.zh: 小桥流水是江南式的宁静美景，温柔安详。
imagery.en: A little bridge over running water: a calm, gentle scene.

imagery.name: 落花
imagery.zh: “飞红”是随水飘落的花瓣，在明媚中透出一点春将归去的惋惜。
imagery.en: “Flying red” petals on the water add a hint of regret: spring will not last.
